title: 最小路径和
statement: 给定 m × n 的非负整数网格 grid，从左上角走到右下角，每步只能向右或向下，求路径上所有数字之和的最小值。

en.title: Minimum Path Sum
en.statement: Given an m × n grid of non-negative integers, walk from the top-left corner to the bottom-right corner moving only right or down at each step, and find the minimum possible sum of all numbers along the path.

complexity.space: O(n) extra space (rolling array); accumulating in place on grid achieves O(1)
complexity.notes: m and n are the numbers of rows and columns of the grid; the input grid does not count toward extra space. dp[i][j] = grid[i][j] + min(above, left).

en.acmIoSpec: stdin: first line the row count m; then m lines, each starting with the column count n followed by n integers. stdout: one integer, the minimum path sum.

complexity.space: O(n) 额外空间（滚动数组）；直接在 grid 上原地累加可做到 O(1)
complexity.officialRequirement: 官方未强制复杂度要求。
complexity.notes: m、n 为网格行数与列数，输入网格不计入额外空间。dp[i][j] = grid[i][j] + min(上方, 左方)。

cpp.acmIoSpec: stdin：第一行行数 m；随后 m 行，每行先写列数 n 再写 n 个整数。stdout：一个整数，最小路径和。
